description: The kinds of source an election result is cited from: a contest file's source.kind (data/elections-source/data/elections/**), and the kind of every citation the provenance build gives a contest (scripts/build/build-election-provenance.mjs, the records' citations table). Each kind's label is what a contest's Sources panel calls it after the title (site/browse/browse.js citationHtml); an empty label shows no kind. Schema: packages/registries/schemas/source-kinds.schema.json; views: packages/registries/src/source-kinds.mjs. Not the register-of-interests source kinds (Browse's 'Source kind' filter), which are a separate vocabulary.

kinds.meaning: a newspaper report of the result
kinds.label: newspaper

kinds.meaning: a newspaper report of the result (the older spelling of news)
kinds.label: newspaper

kinds.meaning: an official return, declaration or notice
kinds.label: official return or notice

kinds.meaning: an official count sheet (one contest; shown without a kind, as before)
a book or other print, as a Wikipedia citation classes it
kinds.label: book

kinds.meaning: a compilation of results, printed or online
kinds.label: results compilation

kinds.meaning: a street or trade directory's list of a council's members (the Belfast and Ulster Directory): who sat after an election, not the poll
kinds.label: directory

kinds.meaning: any other source (shown without a kind)
